definitions.mitt_pixels: distance between the assistant's and the person's mitt point on the same decision frame (both marked), source pixels
definitions.output_feet: assistant's published plate_feet (JSONL) minus the person's mitt mapped through the person's plate front edge and the game's hop-2 matrix, feet
definitions.assistant abstention_rate: unavailable lines / lines in the game's output
definitions.person_abstention_rate: frames the person marked hidden / not in setup / not centre field, over the frames the person decided

m3_requirement.rule: at least 50 person-marked pitches over at least 2 evaluation games

coverage.selection: pitches the condensed game shows (mostly plate-appearance-ending)

no_threshold: no pass/fail threshold was set in advance; the numbers are reported with n
